basis.cost: fob_eur from pricing_list_pn — the class-implied landed cost, NOT a purchase cost
basis.competitor: iam_ks_price_gap.csv, median across distributors, same-shop listings

caveats: Cost is the class-implied landed cost from the class factor, not a purchase price. Where the class factor is generous the 'cost' is understated and the headroom overstated; where it is aggressive the reverse. The direction of the error is not known per part.
The reach analysis rests on 43 part numbers across up to 18 markets, all tagged brand tier 1 with one or two competitors. It is a signal, not a measurement of the book.
The Autodoc risk file (298 part numbers) was NOT used: its price column carries the identical value 2.34 on 277 of 298 rows and is not usable as a competitor price.
The scenario table holds cost fixed and ignores supersession, mix and volume response. It prices the arithmetic of a margin target, not its consequence.
